_comment: Example service definition for a workload that opts into monitoring. The MONITORING_* environment variables and the log bind are the only additions needed. NOTE 1: the variables must live inside 'deployment', not at the top level -- the exchange discards unknown top-level fields. NOTE 2: privileged:true is required for a writable bind to the root-owned /var/log/workloads; without it the agent refuses the deployment. See service.definition.named-volume.json for a non-privileged alternative.
label: Sample monitored sensor service
description: A workload that writes logs to a shared mount and opts into LLM-based monitoring.
